checkpoint.note: The full 50-capability/17-package build remains active and unfinished. Saved facial and original-container video/audio review now have scoped source/export/restart acceptance. Final integrated-source portable connected verification passes 22 checks/four scans, with one automatic report and unchanged source/original workspace. Shared exact-frame pixels pass 25 checks. Next: configured core QA catalog and the distinct GNAT vertical journey; GNAT remains disabled at this checkpoint. See docs/WORKSTREAM.md and the publication handoff for exact evidence and broader gaps.

scope_policy: Every registered capability has exactly one owning work package. Tiers schedule integration; none are silently removed. Planned acceptance is not completion evidence.
parallelization: BWP08-BWP12 can run independently after shared BWP01-BWP06 contracts stabilize; BWP13 integrates every enabled pack before release.
external_inputs: Named hardware and licensed SDK access for claimed live profiles
Selected entitled facial/AU provider or locally pinned model with reference outputs
Source-bound procedure/scorer profiles and materials for newly enabled tasks
GitHub destination and selected distribution licence before publication
Selected HTTPS hosting/storage destination and operator configuration before opening hosted participant recruitment; local lab operation is independently deliverable

work_packages.title: Shared identity, schemas and migrations
acceptance: Old drafts/reports reopen; unknown/stale references fail.
Large tick strings, units, repeated exposures, gaps and nulls survive cross-language fixtures.
Workspace/project/membership, dataset versions, templates, deployments, collection windows, enrollment/waves and design lineage have explicit identity and migration contracts.
Migration indexes every retained legacy report/protocol and preserves old readers; clone/import remaps design references without joining unrelated local records.

work_packages.title: Transactions, objects and durable jobs
acceptance: Duplicate allocation/job requests are idempotent; conflicts are explicit.
Crash/cancel/retry cannot publish partial artifacts; leases and attempts recover.
Raw objects, audit/outbox and database restore form a consistent snapshot.
Selected workspace catalog and immutable object storage support authorized dataset reuse, independent source provenance, version history and recoverable relocation.
Consent/eligibility precede transactional quota/assignment reservation; concurrent final-seat starts, expiry, duplicate/revoked tokens and access to another project are exercised.
Archive, purge and backup restore are distinct; restore applies restricted/deleted-object policy and does not automatically reactivate accepting endpoints.

work_packages.title: Study and method compiler
acceptance: Every enabled template compiles its controls, order, baseline, practice, checks, timings and analysis prerequisites.
Missing source-bound procedure/scorer or channel units prevent analytical activation.

Blank/template/clone/import design routes produce versioned drafts; design-only cloning keeps permitted stimuli/AOIs/questions/recipes, fresh IDs, recorded lineage and zero observed participant state.
Independent fixtures verify portable design graph, condition/baseline, timing, seed, AOI and scoring equivalence; live revisions stay pinned when library assets/templates change.

work_packages.title: Questionnaire builder and executor
proposed_ownership: versioned questionnaire schema with original browser execution
acceptance: Question types, branches, validation, randomization, back navigation and response history agree in R/browser fixtures.
Scale keys and missing/prorating rules match independent examples.
Keyboard/list alternatives and exposure-linked reports work end to end.
Reusable question/scale blocks and portable imports preserve internal references, translations, consent text, display logic and scoring keys without transferring participant responses.

work_packages.title: Participant runner and recovery
acceptance: Preload, focus loss, failed asset, reload, disconnect and duplicate event delivery have declared outcomes.
First/error/corrected responses and observed presentation IDs remain distinct.
Frozen assignment survives retry; preview does not consume live allocation.
Frozen participant appearance, luminance, geometry, motion and timing are isolated from researcher/OS theme preferences; accommodation changes require an explicit protocol profile.
Pilot and lab/hosted releases bind protocol, assets and runner; a fresh browser follows the actual participant link through scoped access, consent, eligibility, setup and collection.

Participant endpoints never expose researcher administration, contacts or other sessions; public versus invited access, waves, allowed resume, distinct endings and approved return destinations have fixtures.
Pause/close block new enrollment according to policy while active runs and pending receipts remain explicit; failed deployment cannot advertise a ready URL.

work_packages.title: Acquisition and normalization adapters
acceptance: Synthetic/replay input seals a truthful multi-stream run including markers/gaps.
XDF/BIDS/SNIRF and named vendor paths preserve units/coordinates/timestamps.
Resource limits, sidecar restart and source-reset handling are tested before physical support claims.
A first-class Data library accepts multi-file imports with preview/dictionary/unit/clock/identity mapping, duplicate resolution and source provenance; curation creates a new immutable version.

work_packages.title: Complete gaze and AOI journey
acceptance: One documented raw importer yields checked fixations/AOI metrics and linked liking.
AOI proposals support correction/undo and parameter changes invalidate descendants.
TTFF censoring, denominators, pupil/blink baselines and independent reference cases reproduce.

work_packages.title: EEG and extended neural methods
acceptance: EEG reference/filter/epoch/PSD/TFR recipes run import to report with retained-trial counts.
Native-file and artifact fixtures complement existing analytic checks.
Extension recipes have explicit stimulation, montage/optode, wavelength, GLM or connectivity prerequisites.

work_packages.title: Peripheral physiology methods
acceptance: Each enabled recipe retains calibrated units, valid support, masks, baselines and effective parameters.
EDA morphology/deconvolution, beat/breath/EMG events and condition summaries match named reference fixtures.
Nonresponse, missingness, correction and overlap rules remain separate; extension methods are not implied by library availability.

work_packages.title: Implicit and cognitive task packs
proposed_ownership: versioned task profiles with original browser execution and R scoring
acceptance: Each activated profile binds a source-versioned procedure/scorer and control/allocation rules.
Independent direction/error/exclusion cases and event replay match reports.
Correction-inclusive timing, deadlines, stimulus timing and physical movement semantics remain explicit; no generic D score for every task.

work_packages.title: Webcam, face, motion and assisted AOIs
acceptance: Frame timestamps, no-face/occlusion/multi-face states and model hashes survive import to report.
Calibrated webcam gaze has held-out spatial error; geometry is not treated as screen coordinates.
Native expression/AU outputs bind actual model/provider support; rPPG/respiration have simultaneous-reference benchmarks.
Vision proposals carry model/geometry provenance and human correction history.

work_packages.title: Voice and acoustic measures
acceptance: PCM/sample-rate/channel/gain and speech segmentation are preserved.
Known pitch/RMS cases plus representative voiced/unvoiced references reproduce.
Acoustics, transcript text and optional model-inferred affect remain separate outputs.

work_packages.title: Multimodal statistics and automated reports
acceptance: Automatic jobs assemble eligible results without erasing good modalities when another fails.
Paired/hierarchical inference respects participants, stimuli, order, missingness and multiplicity.
Report snapshot reproduces from sealed inputs and configuration; all enabled packs supply at least one vertical report fixture.

Historical report snapshots remain browsable independently of the current draft; reanalysis fixes input/cohort versions and creates comparable new outputs without recollecting or copying observations.
Finalization resolves late/incomplete uploads under policy, freezes a cohort, and preserves prior reports when collection reopens in a new window.

work_packages.title: Explicit choice and advanced designs
acceptance: Choice-set design, attributes/levels, allocation and outside choices are preserved.
Source-bound utility/MaxDiff model and uncertainty agree with reference examples.

work_packages.title: Guided UX, review and research operations
acceptance: Plan-to-Results journeys support autosave/resume/undo, batch import and exception-driven review.
Keyboard/focus/reflow/screen-reader checks cover enabled flows; undergraduate task completion and comprehension are measured.
Study/participant history and retention/export operations preserve provenance.
All 50 capability entries use the 13 shared card families, one readiness summary and linked phase/timeline/result records; unavailable profiles have a concrete supported route or status.

The 34 planned whole-journey scenarios gain scoped implementation evidence, including partial streams, failed jobs, AOI correction, question referents and recovery; measured action/time/comprehension outcomes remain distinguishable from targets.

Brohn logo, 32 icons, local font and shared tokens are integrated into actual empty/populated/processing/failure/recovery states; application contrast, keyboard, focus, reflow, reduced motion and plot alternatives are verified independently of the static preview.

Home, Studies, Data library and Design library surround study planning, questionnaires/tasks, collection, review, results and history; search/filter/archive/history recover after restart with an actual next action.
Clone, save template, export design and import design are first-class accessible actions with destination/contents previews and actionable dependency fixes.

UX-J19-UX-J34 exercise historical research, curation, delivery, enrollment/waves/endings, closure, clone/reanalysis, portable designs, sharing and retention; planned targets are not achieved usability evidence.

work_packages.title: Named device and naturalistic extensions
acceptance: Exact device/OS/SDK profiles are recorded; physical onset/synchronization and failure recovery are measured.
World/scene/VR coordinates, device calibration and sensor-native measures have their own fixtures.
Unavailable physical inputs keep the corresponding support entry unavailable without blocking imported-data workflows.

work_packages.title: Packaging, backup and open-source release
proposed_ownership: introduction, sample onboarding and release assets
acceptance: Clean-machine setup and backup restore reproduce a declared supported configuration.
Repository destination/licence and dependency/model redistribution are resolved before publication.
Release includes actual enabled capability evidence and visible unsupported entries; optional device packs do not become implied support.
Introduction copy, an honestly labelled fictional sample, first-study guidance and demonstration assets follow the introduction/launch plan and the shared brand system.

Every demonstration and public claim identifies the release-enabled journey, imported/synthetic/live origin and named-device or model evidence; planned capabilities and unmeasured usability targets remain labelled.

Sample-to-own-study onboarding and report comprehension are evaluated against the planned journeys before stronger completion/speed claims; no outbound launch action is implied by preparing these assets.

Versioned .brohn-study.zip export/import roundtrips on a clean supported installation, includes permitted design assets and rejects unsafe/corrupt/incompatible archives atomically without execution or automatic collection.

The hosted profile includes HTTPS, researcher authentication, project isolation, bounded participant APIs, operational monitoring and consistent storage/restore evidence before remote recruitment opens.

Frozen report sharing has explicit audience/expiry/revocation; backup restores full authorized history and object integrity with secrets/withdrawal handling, while archive restoration never reopens recruitment.

operational_scope: UX-J19-UX-J34 and 15 lifecycle areas are required alongside the original scientific/accessibility journeys. Five study tabs alone do not satisfy platform completion.

delivery_gates.acceptance: Configured lab runner, enrollment/receipt/closure and retained-history journey works without a cloud account; no external reachability is inferred from loopback.
Configured HTTPS host, authentication, access isolation, pinned runner, bounded uploads, monitoring and restore are exercised before opening external participant links.
